info.name: Open a stream session for an existing job

items.docs:
Returns a short-lived URL (5-minute TTL) that you open with
EventSource (or any SSE client) to receive a live feed of
progress events for the job identified by `callback_id`. The
token in the URL is bound to your API key and to that
`callback_id` only.

See the [Streaming guide](/docs/streaming) for the full
walk-through, the event catalog, and reconnect semantics.
